segments.english:
11844 — Hind bint Usayd

Usayd is in the diminutive form. Her father was Usayd ibn Hudayr, and she was an Ansari woman.(4)

(1) Usd al-Ghaba, entry no. 7341; al-Thiqat, 3/439; A'lam al-Nisa, 5/221; al-Istibsar, p. 216; al-Tajrid, 2/309.

(2) See the verses in Usd al-Ghaba, entry no. 7341.

(3) See the verses in Usd al-Ghaba, entry no. 7341.

(4) A'lam al-Nisa, 5/221; al-Istibsar, p. 216; al-Tajrid, 2/309; Hashiyat al-Ikmal, 2/482; Usd al-Ghaba, entry no. 7342; al-Isti'ab, entry no. 5664.

segments.arabic: تقدّم نسبها مع والدها. قال ابن مندة: لها ذكر في حديث محمد بن عبد الرّحمن بن سعد بن زرارة. وقال أبو عمر: روى أبو الرجال عنها عن النّبي ﵌ أنه كان يخطب بالقرآن، قالت: وما تعلّمت سورة «ق» إلا من كثرة ما كنت أسمعه يخطب بها على المنبر.
segments.english: Her lineage was given above with that of her father. Ibn Mandah said: She is mentioned in the hadith of Muhammad ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Sa'd ibn Zurara. Abu Umar said: Abu al-Rijal narrated from her, from the Prophet—may Allah bless him and grant him peace—that he would use the Qur'an in his sermons. She said, “I learned Surat Qaf only because I so often heard him use it in sermons from the pulpit.”

names.arabic: محمد بن عبد الرحمن بن سعد بن زرارة
